summary.description: Successfully initialized Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project with Tailwind CSS, ESLint, Prettier, and base folder structure for CMMS SaaS Web UI.

actionsPerformed.details: Created new Vite project with React 18 and TypeScript template in /workspace/cmms-web-ui

Installed all required dependencies including React 18.3.1, Vite 5.4.0, TypeScript 5.5.4, Tailwind CSS 3.4.10, Zustand 4.5.5, React Router 6.26.1, Axios 1.7.7, Recharts 2.12.7, and development tools (ESLint, Prettier)
Created vite.config.ts with path aliases (@/), API proxy configuration, and build settings
Created tailwind.config.js with logical properties for RTL/LTR support, custom color variables for status/safety/priority, and disabled physical direction-specific plugins
Created tsconfig.json and tsconfig.node.json with strict mode, path aliases, and bundler module resolution
Created .eslintrc.cjs with TypeScript, React Hooks, and Prettier integration
Created .prettierrc.json with project coding standards (single quotes, 100 char width, 2 space tabs)
Created src/index.css with CSS variables for spacing, layout dimensions, status/safety/priority colors, neutral colors, and logical properties for RTL/LTR
Created lib/cn.ts (clsx + tailwind-merge utility), lib/constants.ts (enums for roles, statuses, priorities, permissions), and lib/permissions.ts (permission checking functions)
Created types/index.ts with comprehensive TypeScript interfaces for User, Auth, Assets, Work Orders, Templates, Cycles, Tickets, Notifications, AI, and Dashboard
Created api/client.ts with Axios instance, request/response interceptors for JWT injection and 401 refresh logic, and token storage utilities
Created src/ directory structure: components/ui, components/layout, components/auth, pages, stores, lib, hooks, types, api, constants, utils
Created index.html, src/main.tsx, and src/App.tsx with basic routing setup
Created .env.example with API base URL and feature flags

rtlLtrSupport.method: CSS logical properties with data-dir attribute toggling

features: JWT token injection via request interceptor
Automatic redirect to login on refresh failure

notes: All dependencies installed with exact versions as specified or latest compatible versions
Tailwind CSS configured with logical properties for proper RTL/LTR support
TypeScript strict mode enabled for type safety
Path alias '@/' configured for clean imports from src/
ESLint and Prettier configured with React/TypeScript best practices
API client ready for JWT authentication with automatic refresh flow
Comprehensive type definitions created for all major entities
Permission system provides role-based access control foundation

Focus styles are defined in index.css. Continue aria-* implementation in Piece 13 as planned
Current Vite config has sourcemaps enabled for development. Consider disabling for production builds if not needed
Create .env.local file for local development based on .env.example template
